original_registry_entry.issuing_organisation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
original_registry_entry.exact_document_title: Acute kidney injury: prevention, detection and management
original_registry_entry.version: NICE guideline NG148, current recommendations page reviewed 2026-07-16
original_registry_entry.jurisdiction: England, United Kingdom; international guidance requiring UAE adaptation
original_registry_entry.population: Adults, children and young people with or recovering from acute kidney injury.
original_registry_entry.clinical_setting: Hospital discharge planning, outpatient renal follow-up and primary or specialist monitoring.
original_registry_entry.applicability_note: Exact for documenting AKI episode, discharge follow-up responsibility, serum-creatinine monitoring, renal referral context, renal-replacement information and risk discussion. It does not interpret results or prescribe treatment.

exact_sections.heading: Recommendations 1.5.15–1.5.17 — monitoring and referral after acute kidney injury
exact_sections.evidence_summary: Supports recording serum-creatinine monitoring after AKI, stability or degree of renal function at discharge, and clinician-considered nephrology referral context.

exact_sections.heading: Recommendations 1.6.1–1.6.4 — information, support and future care after AKI
exact_sections.evidence_summary: Supports documenting monitoring, prognosis, self-management, renal-replacement information, dehydration and medicine-risk discussion without generating advice automatically.

exact_sections.heading: Quality statement 6 — clinical review after hospital discharge
exact_sections.evidence_summary: Supports documenting that discharge plans identify AKI and the timing and responsibility for follow-up clinical review.
